entity: US FDA-covered trials that never posted results (share of covered trials, phase 2-4, finished 2017-01 to 2022-06)
what_we_add: The 706 trials, 8.6% of a defined 2017-2022 completion cohort, and 152,850 enrolled patients. No source states any of those counts.
why: FDA and the law-review piece name the entity and state the finding in words: covered US trials failing to post results, FDA reminding 2,200 sponsors. FDA's 29.6% covers all past-deadline studies, a different denominator and window, so it can't be lined up against 8.6% and isn't a contradiction.
